steps.content: In the freezing seawater, you use the shackles' power to steady yourself, descending alone into the depths in search of that familiar white figure.

This time, you are no longer the captive of the Abyss. You are an intruder, your mere presence stirring terrifying echoes in the eerily silent Abyss. Moans, whispers, howls, and growls—these noises resemble the prelude to death for the living, yet also akin to the eruption of long-decayed corpses.
You are a rolling mass of thorns, ceaselessly shredding any who dare to attack.
Your very arrival heralds destruction, marking a confrontation between two different powers that throws these waters into absolute chaos.
